description: Render a screenshot set to store-ready PNGs SERVER-SIDE (no browser needed) and save them as one ZIP per locale in output_dir — ready for App Store Connect / Play Console upload. Rendering happens through the same engine as the Screenshot Studio editor. Writes to the filesystem of the machine running the MCP server, so this tool is for local (stdio) use; over the hosted transport call GET /api/v1/screenshots/sets/:id/export directly instead.

all_locales.description: Export the source locale plus every enabled locale.

locales.description: Locales to export (e.g. ["de-DE","ja"]). Use the set's source locale code for the source renders. Omit together with all_locales for source-only.

output_dir.description: Directory to write the ZIPs into (created if missing). One ZIP per locale, named <locale>.zip, each containing store-ready 01.png…NN.png.

name: sonar_export_screenshots
title: Export Screenshots (PNG)
